# Christofer Yusalfino

> Christofer Yusalfino is a Jakarta-based performance marketing manager with 6+ years managing paid media across Meta, TikTok and Google Ads. He has delivered up to 6.2x ROAS on Meta Collaborative Ads and reduced cost per lead by 97%, from USD 40 to under USD 1. He is open to fully remote roles with companies in the US and Europe.

Christofer Yusalfino is currently Digital Manager at Omnicom Media in Jakarta, Indonesia, leading digital strategy for a leading B2C telecommunications provider and managing a team of four planners. He previously worked at WPP Media (formerly GroupM) as a Connection Media Planner, and as a remote contract Paid Media Specialist for an agency in New South Wales, Australia, running campaigns across nine markets including the US and APAC.

Verified campaign results:

- 6.2x return on ad spend on Meta Collaborative Ads (CPAS) for a beauty and personal-care brand
- 97% cost-per-lead reduction, from USD 40 to under USD 1, within a single year
- 670,000+ first-party retail leads generated in 2024 while marketing spend fell 38%
- USD 0.49 cost per Click-to-WhatsApp conversation against a USD 1.36 market benchmark
- USD 0.45 cost per newsletter subscriber on Google Performance Max against a USD 2.11 benchmark
- Contributed to a 10-point market share increase (42% to 52%) for a men's skincare brand, validated by Nielsen

Certifications: Meta Certified Media Planning Professional, Meta Media Buying Professional, Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate, TikTok Certified Media Buying, Google Ads (Display, Search, Video, Measurement), Google Project Management Certificate, IELTS 7.0 (C1).

## Case studies

- [Meta CPAS on Shopee — 6.18x ROAS](https://www.yusalfino.com/case-studies/meta-cpas-shopee-roas.html): How a Meta Collaborative Ads campaign for a B2C beauty and personal-care brand reached 6.18x ROAS and 41,000+ marketplace sales at USD 0.70 cost per acquisition, February to April 2024. Answers questions such as: what is Meta CPAS, what is a good CPAS ROAS benchmark, and how long a CPAS retargeting window should be. Contains original operator detail on why a 60-day buyer window matched the beauty replenishment cycle.
- [Cutting cost per lead by 97%](https://www.yusalfino.com/case-studies/cost-per-lead-reduction.html): How newsletter-subscription cost per lead fell from USD 40 to under USD 1 within a year, producing 280,000+ first-party leads, then more than doubled to 670,000+ leads in 2024 while spend dropped 38%. Answers questions such as: how to reduce cost per lead, whether lead volume can grow while ad spend falls, and what a good cost per lead is for newsletter subscriptions in Southeast Asia.
- [TikTok Shop GMV Max](https://www.yusalfino.com/case-studies/tiktok-shop-gmv-max.html): Ten months operating TikTok Shop GMV Max catalogue product ads for a beauty and personal-care brand against a 7.0x monthly ROAS target on a USD 6,000–9,000 monthly budget, January to October 2025. Answers questions such as: what is TikTok Shop GMV Max, how GMV Max differs from manual TikTok ads campaigns, and what ROAS target is realistic. Contains original operator detail on why a high return target can starve an automated campaign of delivery.
